name: Tuhwentee
description:
Welcome to Tuhwentee

Custom Hardcore Minecraft for Java & Bedrock

Build a home, earn your rewards, and make every life count. Tuhwentee brings Java and Bedrock players together for a Hardcore experience packed with custom features and long-term progression.

Here’s just the tip of the iceberg:

• Leveling & Prestiging

• Land Claiming

• Custom Pets & Hats

• Particle Effects

• Events

• And much more!

Every level unlocks a reward. Along the way, you can earn:

• Decrafting abilities

• Extra building reach

• Home Waystones

• Cosmetic titles

• Removal of anvil repair limits

• Portable workstations

• Biome locator compasses

• Vein Miners

• Tree Harvester

• Hundreds of other rewards

You won’t reach the maximum level in a single day... there’s always another milestone to work toward.

We carefully review applications to help keep griefers and trolls out and build a community where your time, effort, and creations are respected.

Welcome to Tuhwentee.
